purpose: Per-lease +44 800 PSTN claim repeatability and AWS::Connect::PhoneNumber.TargetArn association behaviour
target_arn_outcome: TargetArn binding via AWS::Connect::PhoneNumber works directly. The PhoneNumber resource (with TargetArn=ConnectInstance.Arn, Type=TOLL_FREE, CountryCode=GB) succeeded on first attempt. A separate AssociatePhoneNumberContactFlow custom resource is still required to bind the number to a specific contact flow (Phase 9.4).
post_lease_cleanup: isb close-account is mandatory; the number remains attached to the AWS account after stack delete. Verified by reading the DeletionPolicy on the resource.
notes: Single attempt, single account. To establish repeatability, this should be re-run across at least 5 fresh pool accounts before NDX:Try goes live with this scenario on the public portal. As a single-attempt result, this proves it CAN work but not that it ALWAYS works.
